whitespace = Regex(r"\s")

# Hexadecimal string with optional "0x" prefix
hex_str = Regex(r"(?:0x|0X)?[0-9a-fA-F]+")

# UUID version 4 with variant bits [89abAB]
uuid4 = Regex(
    r"[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-"
    r"[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-"
    r"4[0-9a-fA-F]{3}-"
    r"[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-"
    r"[0-9a-fA-F]{12}"
)

# IPv4 address with each octet in 0-255
ipv4 = Regex(
    r"(?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.){3}"
    r"(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)"
)

python -c "
import re
from outlines.types import hex_str, uuid4, ipv4
assert hex_str.pattern and uuid4.pattern and ipv4.pattern
m = lambda p, s: re.fullmatch(p, s) is not None
# hex
assert m(hex_str.pattern, '0x1aF'); assert m(hex_str.pattern, 'abc'); assert not m(hex_str.pattern, '0x'); assert not m(hex_str.pattern, 'xyz'); assert not m(hex_str.pattern, '')
# uuid4
assert m(uuid4.pattern, '123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000')
assert m(uuid4.pattern, '123E4567-E89B-42D3-A456-426614174000')
assert not m(uuid4.pattern, '123e4567-e89b-52d3-a456-426614174000')  # wrong version
assert not m(uuid4.pattern, '123e4567-e89b-42d3-c456-426614174000')  # wrong variant
# ipv4
assert m(ipv4.pattern, '255.255.255.255'); assert m(ipv4.pattern, '0.0.0.0'); assert m(ipv4.pattern, '192.168.1.1')
assert not m(ipv4.pattern, '256.1.1.1'); assert not m(ipv4.pattern, '1.2.3'); assert not m(ipv4.pattern, '1.2.3.4.5')
print('ok')
"
